notes: Two rail-shape machines exist: place.c (struct rail, rail_refresh) for the placement path and blockcb.c (struct rail, rail_shape) for onBlockAdded/neighbour callbacks; they should be merged before the GPU port. Rails generate in mineshaft corridors (mineshaft_blocks.c) and are placeable; minecarts themselves are off (world.conf minecarts = off).
